title: micranthes caroliniana
intro: Micranthes caroliniana, commonly known as Carolina saxifrage, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Saxifragaceae family. It is native to the southeastern United States and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of M. caroliniana include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
